game.label: Your Dante's Inferno Xbox 360 game files: the folder with default.xex (extract your disc image with extract-xiso).

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: The game runs at 60 on the console. Higher rates are smoother; menus and minigames stay at the right speed. Use a rate your screen can show.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at. Automatic uses your screen's own resolution.

settings.label: Aspect ratio
settings.help: The shape of the picture. Automatic matches the resolution, so ultrawide screens get the wide view.

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Fullscreen fills your screen. Windowed lets you switch apps quickly.

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.help: SMAA smooths jagged edges. Costs little.

settings.label: Shadow quality
settings.help: The size of the shadow maps. Higher is sharper and needs a faster graphics card.

settings.label: Show FPS
settings.help: The frame rate in the top left corner of the game.

actions.label: Saves and settings
actions.help: Your saves and the shader cache.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: The game's logs, to send with a bug report.

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Shaders the game has built. Clearing only helps if graphics look wrong after an update.
